question: On which day in 2025 did India and Pakistan agree to a US-brokered ceasefire with immediate effect?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10 May**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• On May 10, 2025, India and Pakistan agreed to a **US-brokered ceasefire** with immediate effect.
 
• This agreement marked an important milestone in the efforts to ease tensions between the two nuclear-armed nations.
 
• The ceasefire aimed to end hostilities along the highly sensitive Line of Control (LoC) in Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• The US facilitated this agreement as part of its diplomatic efforts to maintain stability in the South Asian region.
 
• Ceasefires like these are crucial in mitigating border conflicts and ensuring peace in one of the world's most volatile regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ceasefire Agreement**

 
 
• The Line of Control (LoC) between India and Pakistan has been a longstanding point of conflict, with frequent ceasefire violations.
 
• The US and other international actors have historically played a role in mediating peace efforts between the two nations.
 
• The 2025 ceasefire agreement was seen as a positive step toward reducing tensions in the region and improving bilateral relations.
 
• Such agreements are often fragile and require sustained efforts to ensure long-term peace and stability.
